Then once inside, it was shoulder to shoulder.

The guide was pleasant, but when all was said and done, it was easier to just walk around and read all the signs ourselves. The guide didn’t offer anything unique or special, more of an obstacle than helpful.

If I could do it over again, I’d buy the ticket on the website with a reserved time for entry.

This was my second trip to La Sagrada Familia but it had been 4 years since the first time. The guide spent most of their time with us walking around the outside, explaining what we were looking at. The details they shared made it SO much better. Clearly it's visually stimulating but we spent an additional hour on our own afterwards circling the building based on what we learned. I will say the group was quite large so we stuck close to the guide to be sure to hear everything.

Vincent was an awesome guide and very knowledgeable. He kept us interested the entire tour and had great insight. We highly recommend the 9am tour as you get priority access, we were first to enter while the long libes were forming, and were able to take pictures before others crowded the place. 5 stars!!

Hi
We booked this tour only to skip the line, and have done previous tours in other cities with different companies. The guide was good, but 30 people on one tour is too many other tours had around 20 maximum. I felt sorry for the guide that he had so many people.
Sagrada Familia is a must visit, my favorite church in the whole world (and I am not religious).

We arrived an hour late for the tour because of a pile up on the motorway and this company wanted to charge us an extra 100 euros to go around the cathedral on top of the 160 we’d already paid. Take it or leave it - very poor customer service.
We decided to cut our losses, but it made for a very unhappy start to our day in the city.

joseph was a great guide. he was full was information I would have never got on my own.
all the little details were special
An amazing place that changes every time we visit it! A stunning master piece Gaudí at its best! Priority beat the que is a must at this time of the year as the ques are long!

We took this tour on our second day in Barcelona. Marta was extremely friendly and very knowledgeable about La Sagrada Familia and the history of the monument. Check-in was smooth, and we had a small group (about 15) so it was easy to stay together and ask questions along the way.
The stained glass windows in behind the powerful granite central pillars are awe inspiring. The private tour allows access to the building and cuts lineup times to nil

We bought tickets on line for the second morning we were in Barcelona.....9 am. This worked out very well as we got right in when it opened and the crowds later are too much. It is the most amazing structure and I only wish that we had more time to visit some of Gaudi's other buildings.
Very good tour. Guide was excellent. Highly recommend. Great meeting place right across from the cathedral with a very easy walk.

The tour we took was accessible to my wife in an electric wheelchair. When you entered, you were provided with an electronic information device, about the size of a cell phone. You went from area to areas, they were clearly numbered, and listened to a very detailed and will done recording about what you were viewing. To say that the Sagrada Familia is amazing, is an understatement. I promise, you have never seen anything like it, or similar to it! Hope you enjoy it.
Nothing much to explore. Just the place that has been building for centuries! Just take a photo out side. Don't pay for a ticket to get in

Highly recommended skip the line and informative tour of Sagrada Familia with Julia Travel. The tour guide was great and gave us a lot of insights and bts of this beautiful Basicila. This place is always packed with tourists so I would highly suggest getting the tickets beforehand.
Totally worth going !
I would revisit this place after 2018 when the construction is fully completed :)
The guide was SO informative and interesting. You get to see the whole church, skip the long line and learn a ton of history about the Sagrada Familia. Worth every penny.
Had a very enthusiastic guide who explained all the sculptures and their relevance perfectly. Everything made sense after her explanations. Thoroughly recommend this tour
Two languages same time tour, very annoying that guide say things first in english then in Spanish .

Well worth the cost. The tour guide makes everything so easy and is very informative. The meeting place is across the street from the Cathedral, it is not at the cathedral. It took about an hour and a half.

What a beautiful church!
So enjoyable to see the craftsmanship that was needed to construct this beautiful church.
The history was amazing!
It saved a lot of time not having to stand in line. The tour was very informative and interesting although a little rushed.

This tour was excellent! The church is breath taking and absolutely a must see in Barcelona. The guide Sara was very kind and knowledgeable about the church! Our family had a wonderful time. 100% recommend going on the tour to get a thorough description of the cathedral

Good tour. Great descriptions, stories and history explanations. Got inside quite quickly. The headphones used during the tour worked well. However, in my opinion the groups were way to large. I enjoyed the tour and the tour guide was excellent explain in English and Spanish.
I absolutely loved this tour. Our tour guide was extremely knowledgeable and excited to be there with our group. La Sagrada is so beautiful and impressive. This is a MUST SEE in Barcelona!

At $65/person for a family of 7, we certainly expected a better tour than we got. Our reservation was for an tour in English, but was mostly conducted in Spanish. While the tour guide did her best, the massive tour group of 30 people - most of whom were Spanish speaking - was unmanageable. 30 minutes into the tour we had not yet entered the gates and had only discussed the translation process - “when I am speaking Spanish, you English speaking people can take photos”. I would not book with Viator again.

There are no words to describe this place. A once-in-a-lifetime experience. The beauty of this structure is incredible! Our guide was very informative and even assisted with photo ops. This tour even kept our 17 year old son interested.

Save yourself some money and just get a regular ticket - the tour didn’t start in time, the guide wasn’t prepared so we had to wait for him to get tickets, the tour had way too many people, the guide was not aggressive enough so we skipped parts (seeing the models), people on my tour were ignorant and the questions they asked just bogged down the tour and the guide kept answering them. I wish I could have gotten the prerecorded guide - I think I would have learned more and enjoyed it better.
We toured this landmark and learned so much thanks to Jane/Juana!! So knew so much about the various sides of the Sagrada and was so nice!! I would definitely recommend it!!

Totally worth the price. Highly informed Valentina was our tour guide for 12 people. This smaller group than others we saw allowed for all of our questions to be answered. Valentina was careful not to lose anyone in the throng and we felt like we had a lot of dpace around us. Her educated and colorful descriptions enhanced our experience. Highly informative, historically fascinating, engaging, easy to hear. Highly recommend. Well worth the time and money.

Get there 10 minutes early. Stand next to window of official gift shop.
What a time saver! We arrived early and they let us start our audio guide tour early. Audio guide fair quality and sometimes hard to follow sequence of what to look at.......overall an amazing site!
Our guide was friendly and well-informed. She was very skilled in moving our small group through the crowd. Overall an awesome experience.

The experience of visiting a tourist attraction is highly dependent on the guide. In this case, we felt that the guide fell short. Yes we understand that this might be the umpteen time that she’s talking about Gaudí and the Basílica but she was simply going through the motion with no interest. The explanations were very hurried so at the end of the tour, when we wanted to ask questions, did curtly told us that she has another group waiting for her and she cannot explain anything further.

The other aspect that we didn’t enjoy is that the group was really big (30pax) and it was a mix of English and Italian speaking tourists. So the guide had to speak in both languages simultaneously which makes the experience very draggy.

Find another tour agency for a better experience. This attraction is not to be missed.
No waiting and very informational. Jaw dropping. Highly recommend this method of seeing this wonder.

This whole experience was truly amazing. The building itself is an incredible building especially when you see how it reacts with the sunlight. Gaudi's design was truly amazing and the fore-sight. Our guide was good and had many interesting facts plus the entry into the building was easy. A good tour.

We did the 4 pm tour on Nov. 6th. Our group was a bit larger than we expected but it was not a problem once we were provided the audio system. Our guide was extremely knowledgeable. Amazing that he can remember so many dates and historical info! It is hard to capture the beauty of the interior or exterior of the Cathedral as it is all so detailed and in transition. One can only pause and admire the great work of art that it is, and is becoming! Don’t hesitate to do this tour. You will be awestruck!

Our guide was very nice and knowledgeable. It was also nice not to have to wait in the line but since we went off season it might not have taken much longer. During the summer I imagine it would save a lot of time.

We booked well ahead of time and expected to have an English only tour but ended up on a bilingual tour. We had several similar tours while in Spain and I found them generally very good. The Sagrada Familia is an absolute must to visit - it is truly awe-inspiring but if I was doing it again I would consider just getting entry and an audio guide. You are then independent and can go at your own pace as well as hear the commentary. Additionally, although we had skip the line tickets there was still at least a thirty minute wait before we entered.
Very well organized and no waiting in lines. Location is easy to find and the guide provided a great deal of historical information.
You have to see this place. This church has been under construction for quite some time now. And once you visit, you will understand why. You will want to take the fast track, it gets crazy there.

We booked and was well worth it! The crowds were ridiculous. Had a hard time finding the guide with the sign for Barcelona fun as there was no sign held above the crowd like others... she was were we were told but she did blend in. Otherwise a sight that must be seen! Amazing details and history reviewed. Tour is at least 1.5 hrs long . Highly recommended!

I have seen a number of churches in a number of cities in a number of countries, but there are none so personal as the Sagrada Familia - Guadi's love of Christianity & life is felt outside and inside. You just know God loves here.

Once we were in, the tour itself was good. Our tour guide was knowledgeable and we learned some interesting facts. The inside of the church is magnificent and beautiful. I would recommend getting individual tickets instead of the tour.
It took 1 hr + very disappointing the guide was very repetitive,strong accent and very hard to listen
We booked a tour and would recommend since the lines are long if you do not have tickets. Inside and out are something to see and appreciate Gaudí.

We've been here before but the line to get inside was so long that we didn't go in. We are so glad that we chose this tour! Even before we stepped inside we could see so much more of the outer facade as we approached the entrance. Our guide did a fabulous job of pointing things out to us that we would have missed on our own. The inside of the church is so different than the outside it's hard to believe it's the same building. If you're going to La Sagrada Familia this is the way to go!
Our tour guide, Maria, was very knowledgeable. She was patient and made sure that no one got lost in the crowded basilica. Can't wait to visit when the construction is completed.
This is the easiest way into Sagrada Familia. The guide was personable and very knowledgable. My wife walks with a cane and could easily keep up.

Got tickets for the afternoon guided tour from the official website. Quickly entered at the appointed time. Had the tour with Jaume Andreu. What a wonderful tour! Knowledgeable and entertaining. Thanks for bringing the church to life for us!

So glad we booked a tour with Julia Travel and skipped the line. Our guide was knowledgeable and passionate. Our audio devices enabled all members of our group to hear her commentary and be amazed the genius of Gaudi and the evolution of this spectacular building.

The Sagrada Familia surpassed my expectations. Definitely a must-see. Looking forward to its completion in ~7 years, when I'd like to come back and go up into the main central tower. Isabel was an incredible guide, full of so much detailed information, so pleasant and engaged, and very invested in making sure everyone on the tour had an enjoyable experience. Highly recommend!
Wow! The architecture, the stained glass, the towers, the statues, the history, the beauty of Gaudi's transformation and lets not forget the citizens of Barcelona for help in completing it.
Great tour! Worth the visit and booking the fast track tour was great, our guide Montserrat was very knowledgeable! Learned LOTS about the cathedral!

Doing the skip the line guided tour was the way to go. Our guide was super friendly, had a gear sense of humor and was very knowledgeable. The line was long, so paying a little more to skip the line and have a guide was well worth it.

Skipping the queues is highly recommended, especially in peak season and when it's hot. Our guide was obviously very knowledgeable and passionate about the heritage.

Areas of improvement: I could have done with a map to explain the starting point. You start at the Julia offices, not outside the Basilica itself. The audio was a bit hit and miss, but I appreciated it over having to listen to someone shout.
We had a wonderful time learning about this modern marvel. Great guide, and who doesn’t like skipping the line?!
Easy to book; meeting place was easy to find. The guide was informative and provided interesting information about the church and Gaudi.
Really enjoyable and informative guided tour. Our guided was really friendly and the tour lasted about 1.5 hours which was just long enough.

It was so much better to be met by a guide right by the Sagrada Familia and be walked in, bypassing all the long lines of people who are waiting to see it. Worth the money and our guide was very nice and knowledgeable! I learned so much about the history of the church and its architect. Would definitely recommend booking ahead of time, as this is the #1 attraction in Barcelona.

Visited here on the 11am slot and booked tockets with the audio guide. Absolutely amazing building and definitely worth a visit and the guide was helpful. Was nice you could walk round for as long as you wanted. Seemed very organised even though it was busy. Noticed when we were leaving it was even busier than when we arrived may be slightly quieter in the mornings? Be organised in booking your your tickets unlike myself who booked the day before so very limited availability. Would definitely highly recommend

Our family had an outstanding experience visiting Sagrada Familia. It was largely enhanced by having the benefit of a guided tour conducted by a representative from Julia Travel. He gave excellent insights into the details of the site. The whisper machines helped us to clearly hear all of his explanations. We would highly recommend prebooking this tour to fully appreciate the very best site in Barcleona.

A must see!
Check in to the travel agency is smooth. Waited in the air conditioning room next to Sagrada Família. Tour guide is a very nice lady and took time to explain and answer questions.
Fantastic guide, very friendly and informative. Highly recommended. Just the right amount of time. No waiting in line and office was right there

This tour was so good! Not only did we get to enter in a group entrance that we got to walk right through, but we got commentary from a guide! We all got headphones and audio guides, and our tour guide spoke right into his and it traveled to ours, so everyone could hear what he was saying. He showed us the best places to take pictures and pointed out amazing details we might have missed. After he was finished, we were able to explore on our own. Definitely need to choose this tour!
This is a must see. You won't be disappointed. The windows are breathtaking. Plan an early day trip to beat the heat.

Only advantage you get to go ahead of long lines; signed up for an English speaking tour guide but could not understand half of what he was saying and he got irritable when asked to repeat something. We ended up quitting the tour and just going on our own.

Pluses were 1) being guaranteed entry at that time, but see below. 2) skipping the queues 3) sagrada familia, it is amazing, 4) their office is right around the corner from the church

Not so goods...really limited tour. In looking at the amount of spots for the guided audio that the regular entry uses....they had quite a few. I can count how many this tour had on one hand. So to me, it wasn’t really guided. If they meant your are fast tracked in, and limited tour, the write up does not reflect that. Be aware, that they won’t let you in with bare shoulders. Commentary was okay, not very detailed or enthusiastic. Uses earphones to a speaker thing that the guide speaks in to.

Wheelchairs, I think there are ways around. This tour did not have an6one that needed that so I’m not sure. I would suggest you contact the office.

It isn’t the worst I’ve been to, so since one is the worst, I’ll say it is just bad or poor.

We did the self guided tour with audio. Skipped the long line to get in. Our time was perfect at 11 am. This place is unbelievable and amazing. No words can describe this place but "AMAZING"!! Very intrusive security check as well, this not the fault of the tour operator. All in all a self guided audio tour would have been better. All that said, the Sagrada is pretty amazing. Stained glass from inside is super.
We had an amazing experience on this tour and learned so much about the process. Our tour guide definitely loved her job and you could tell. Highly recommend

Very happy with this tour. Julia Travel office is a little tricky to find as as such I was a little late, but they managed to help me catch up with the group before they entered the Basilica. Well worth buying this ticket to skip the lines and get a good look outside, inside, and the museum below. Would recommend this very much.

Think you're missing the queue...nope.
You meet along with 100 other people crowded in a shop 15 mins before & by the time you get thru security that's an hour gone! Just about understood the guide but just think "organic & nature" to yourself & that's about as much as you learn. Suggest you queue yourself & get the hand held radio device.
Incredible once inside thou...no denying that..

Our guide was great and having someone explain all the details included in the design of La Sagrada Familia made the whole experience better. The place is beautiful on its own, but knowing the symbolism and story behind the details in the facade and the interior made it so much more meaningful and helped us appreciate everything even more.

I absolutely loved the guided tour! It's a must if you want to fully grasp the grandness of Gaudi's architecture. So many symbolisms that you may miss without the useful interpretation. Plus skipping the line, where you can wait for hours depending on the day..Sagrada Familia is not to be missed

We stayed in the hotel Rialto which is well positioned off the Rambla. The desk staff were very friendly and helpful.The hotel was warm and clean We used the tourist bus so we could visit all the best places of interest.I Barcelona is a beautiful city.

Attended the 9:30 am tour this morning with Isaac S. as the guide. He was AMAZING! So knowledgeable, engaging and wove a fantastic narrative of the Sagrada Familia story. I walked away an expert :). Thank you for a great time Isaac!

Guide just ok. Not enough information shared as the guide could have, but did not, talk during wait. The church is unreal and there is so much to say but our guide was not very informative. Nice guy but not very good. Way way too big a group. Close to 40 people. So overall .. look somewhere else.

So glad I booked in advance through Julia Travel with priority access. I heard of other visitors queuing for 2 hours and eventually giving up to gain entry. The gentleman who was our guide proved to be a comedian also! He was very informative about Gaudí and The Sagrada Familia, and funny too. Astonishing place and rightly deserves to be the number 1 attraction in Barcelona. Best to get the 10am tour. Upon leaving after 12, the crowds were massive.

Well worthwhile to book a skip the line as it is a very busy place. The guide spoke good English and was very knowledgeable on both Gaudi and the Sagrada Familia. It is quite astounding to think that work is still being completed to Gaudi's original plans of 92 years ago.

The office is easy to find and there is a nice little coffee shop across the street that you can grab a cup of coffee at if you arrive early. Once the tour guide lead us out into the street so that we could see the cathedral, we ended up standing outside in the rain for nearly 30 minutes. The description says this is a fast track and that you can skip the long lines but we stood outside while several other groups went in ahead of us that arrived later. We were told that Segrada Família has agreements with certain groups and that they are given preference. Our tour guide was nice and very knowledgeable. The cathedral was breathe taking and anyone that visits Barcelona HAS to see it. All in all it was a good experience but maybe the words “fast track” should be removed.
Our tour was fantastic would recommend it to anyone visiting Sagrada familia , this was my 3rd visit to Barcelona but my 1st visit inside so worth it

This tour was made so much more enjoyable by our guide Jordy! He gave knowledgable insight above any audio recording and really brought Gaudi’s masterpiece to life by explaining both the history and technique behind its construction. There is so much christian symbolism here which might be overlooked without his tutelage. I would highly recommend this companys tour. Even pouring rain could not dampen the wonder we felt in this odd yet holy spot.

Wonderful tour of the Sagrada Familia. Our tour guide was great and we all really enjoyed it. Best church I have ever been in. The guided tour lasted about an hour and half and then we wandered around the museum in the basement. There is no food on the premises so don’t go in hungry as you will want to spend some time wandering around.
Such a beautiful building inside and out. Took advantage of a tower tour whilst there ... and what a view from the top

As you approach you see the towers and it just gets more impressive the closer you get. It is a BIG tourist attraction and I would recommend booking in advance so you get your time slot. I heard people turning up at 9am and would not get a slot until 12.30...It's impressive to see how they are finishing this 'project' and there is so much detail externally but for me it was the interior that blew me away. Gaudi's use of light is breathtaking. If you want to visit the towers you do need a different ticket.
This tour was wonderful. Our guide Jordi was excellent and helped guide us through the images on the façade and inside the church. This was a great experience and I highly recommend it.
Great informative tour and guide of beautiful church. To skip the queue is a wonderful advantage as can be huge and extremely long.

This tour is well worth the extra few euro... express entry into the most security conscious place ... makes airports look like nursery school...

The tour takes about 90minutes is very informative and crucially gets you inside way way quicker than simply queuing up.

Theres lots of little touches you really would miss without a guide and this made the whole experience even better.

Theres place just to pray if you want but this for the most part isnt really a church (yet) ..

Services here are held every day in the crypt which you cant access from the tour..

As the sun moves different colours are displayed through the amazing stained windows... Id aim for a 4pm tour as the colours toward the end of the day... mmmm.. heavenly!

Beautiful place and a must see for any tourist in Barcelona... and this skip the line tour is equally a must doo!

With an easy check in, departure right on time, our tour made this day in Barcelona at the Sagrada Familia fun and informative. Alexandra was a professional, well spoken and attentive guide. She made certain via eye contact with the members of our tour that we understood what we were looking at on the outside walk about, pointing out details many would have overlooked. The history of the origin of the cathedral was well described. Because she did cover details so completely, when came to question time at regular intervals, we were all well educated by her conversations. Once in the Sagrada Familia, with the personal, just for our use earphones and receivers supplied, her descriptions were clear and very detailed. Perfect pace of speech, perfect speed moving from the museum into the chapel. The pause she had us take as we entered was...a chance to stand in awe of the magnificence and splendor of the scene. The light streaming in, as Alexandra explained, was conceived to change colours as the day progressed, which we witnessed as our time inside was evolving. Clear explanations again of the architectural details, the genius engineering and vision of not only Gaudi but his successors. She went on to explain that the current goal is for completion by 2026 to sadly but joyously mark the death of Gaudi via a freak carriage accident as he crossed a street. Such a talented, multi skilled artist cum architect cum scholar cum visonary. We now fully understand, thanks to Alexandra's passionate focused abilities not only as guide but teacher. We highly recommend this tour. We chose tha 9AM English exclusive tour. This was a good time of day for temperatures outside and then gloriuos light show as the sun worked its way along the stained glass. As we parted her company, we were left to explore all the areas on our own, with the knowledge of perhaps where to satisfy our particular interests. Well done Alexandra, you made our time special. Alexandra is a true professional at her craft and a gifted lady with attention to detail. Excellent tour. Great team at Julia Travel, we hope tpo be back again, perhaps tpo see the completed Sagrada Familia, if not beforer again! Thank you especially to Alexandra.

The tour began at the Julia Travels office, across the street from the Sagrada Familia. We walked around the building before entering as a tour group. The guide took us around the church and was very informative. After about an hour and a half the tour ended. I was able to go back and walk around by myself to take more pictures. There is also a museum at the end of the Sagrada Familia, for those who want even more history.
Would not have gotten as much out of seeing the building had we not done the tour. Tour guide did a good job speaking in English. She was very polite as well.

This was a pleasant surprise. We were on a cruise and this was so much less expensive. Downside- the taxi queue took about an hour to grab one from the port, so we arrived about 15 minutes after the start (not meeting) time of our tour. Shockingly, we expected to plead for a later tour but were told to go to the tour entry gate and the tour guide would meet us. She was there and we joined as the tour began. She was incredibly knowledgeable. It was not an overly long tour but one of the most detailed and informative. A great value and incredibly enjoyable. A do not miss!!

Booking process and ticket pick up easy. Our guide Jordi was very informative and at the same time amusing. This was my second visit in two years and I still found his narrative and the place fascinating.

You must have fast track skip the line. Tour started in travel office across the street. Guide walked group over and gained fast access to the church. She used an audio system that everyone could hear her talking as we walked. She was extremely knowledgeable and engaging. The place truly is one of the most amazing places in the world. You could walk this place on your own and be awestruck but need this tour to explain what you are seeing. It is just amazing. You will ask the question, crazy or genius? There are so many people visiting so do not go without the fast track

This tour met our expectations perfectly. We did an early morning tour which turned out perfect. We avoided the heat and were able to see the amazing stained glass with the morning sun. The tour covered the exterior of the church in excellent detail as well as the interior. At the end, we could stay as long as we desired which gave us time to do the tour on construction and to explore on our own. I highly recommend going early as the church was already getting crowded. Very good tour.

Well organized tour through a stunning building. The Sagrada Famila is a must see. Collection of the booked tickets at the office right in front of the the Sagrada Famila was easy. Everything was prepared and the guide was on time.
There is a security check before you are allowed to enter Sagrada Famila, that means it will take a couple of minutes before you are in.

The ease of access was brilliant as were able to enter via the Group entrance without queuing. The guide spoke very good English and was very knowledgeable about the location. The headsets worked well so that we could hear him. I would recommend this way of visiting the Sagrada Familia.

Wow- amazing architecture and design. Highly recommend this tour. Our guide was great. She was a little pocket rocket. Very knowledgeable and friendly service. Skip the line was really quick so we didn’t spend much time outside waiting in the heat. The history and stories associated to the Basilica are amazing. Highly recommend the visit and guided tour.

Undoubtedly the Sagrada Familia is a building of monumental proportions which deserves the very best when given a guided tour. Unfortunately, this was not my experience. The tour should have been 1hour 30, and was booked as English. It was 1 hour 15 and had Spanish tourists in the group which the guide preferred to talk to. My friend asked a question and was told to wait whilst he spoke to them, not impressed. I wanted to know more about the issues regarding the apartments which are planned to be demolished, he wanted to know which was our preferred colour, the one on the left or right - seriously!
Back to guide school for Carl ( I think that was his name)

Very well organized! It was a small group and was easy to move around and listen to our tour guide who was very knowledgeable! The tour was easy to find, great communication and even though Sagrada was packed, we were able to see everything, hear everything with our groups headphones and take all pictures that we wanted to! Highly recommend this guided tour!

Started off bv assembling across the street from the Cathedral. Led across the street by a very knowledgeable guide who provided a detailed & entertaining explanation of the genesis of this amazing edifice

The Sagrada Familia must be seen with a guide and this was a great way to do it. It was so crowded inside I was happy to have a tour guide who was available to share knowledge about the symbolism I would have otherwise missed.

Seeing inside the Sagrada Familia is a must and having a guide to explain what you are seeing so you understand the significance is a must. Having some knowledge of biblical history is helpful to fully grasp what you are seeing, particularly the sculptures on the outside. Check as to who Veronica was!

To be precise, the tour was fine in letting you pass the long line quicker than others but the service is not good as the system they use is useless with so much noise and the English the guide spoke was not understandable. I had hard time to adjust the frequency to be able to hear his explanation and once I did , his accent was not understandable.

This is one of the most beautiful buildings in Spain
The end product will me amazing. Worth a visit with guided tour

My group and I booked this tour because we heard alot of nightmare stories of people queuing in line for hours just for entry. They delivered on their promise and we skipped the line. The actual tour was very anti climatic, it was pretty much front of church, middle of church, then back of church ending with gift shop.

This tour will get you in to the church faster. It’s educational and the guide was able to answer our groups questions although it was larger (20-25). I liked the fact that our guide remained positive and focused on the incredible architectural marble and effort.

The crowds around Familia Sagrada are insane, so it was nice to have a small group meet down the road, walk in past the crowds and immediately enjoy Saudi's most famous architecture. A relatively brief, but well described tour of the exterior and interior, was much appreciated on a very hot day. Well done.
A must see. Really beautiful and cool symbolism. Without tour wouldn’t really understand building and concepts behind it

The fast track worked really well, the guide was very knowledgable so that we could learn a lot about that fascinating building and with time to ourselves after the official tour we also had the chance to have a closer look at some interesting spots that we saw during the tour. Recommendable for older children and adults, I’d say.
We didn’t know anything about the church but we’re filled in on the tour. The tour guide told us all the best spots to take pics!

Excellent tour with a knowledgeable guide. We have opted for a guide as there are a lot of architectural details that are fascinating to learn first hand. This will be a good tour for a culture geek.

Waiting time may be longer that other fast track tours due to tight security.

The tour is really informative and definitely worthwhile. The guide very knowledgeable pointed out little details that one would not see or know. She took the time to make sure we understood and was very engaged. We MOST definitely recommend this guided tour. We came away with a lot of insight into the Sagrada Familia.
Best way to see Sagrada Familia. Very informative and interesting. Definitely reccommend. Able to quickly get in not waiting in long queues.

Their meet up point is in one corner next of Família Sagrada. Small office, gotta pay attention to find it. Peter our tour guy was an older gentleman who is very knowledgeable. We got into Família Sagrada almost without any wait. Love it and recommend it.

There are few words to describe the Familia.
Amazing. Sensational. Unbelievable. All these words fall short of the beauty of the monument, that will grace this beautiful part of the world for centuries to come.
I’m honoured to have visited.

An easy way to see a Barcelona landmark.
Tour office is a block from the church and the guide takes care of everything.
Vincent was an enthusiastic presenter and allowed the group plenty of time to view and explore while still keeping us together.
The audio enhancement is a great idea in such a busy area.
If crowds aren’t your thing, go early (9am is early in Spain) as the place fills up later.

So beautiful! It would be a shame to waste time outside, standing in line for it! Whether you do the guided tour or the audio guide, skip that line and head straight for the eye-popping beauty of neo-Gothic-meets-modernist architecture.

Hola, my husband & I just did this incredibly fascinating tour of the SF with Martha on 7/1/19. She is warm, very knowledgeable of the history and art of the church. Small group, plenty of time in church on the tour (90 min.), and she asked us several times if there were questions. The tour was much more that I expected, loved every minute and learned a lot, thank you Martha! (I would recommend to book the tour as early as possible in the summer to avoid heat & crowds. Bring a hat & water as some of it is outdoors to look at front & back of church).

We had an awesome tour guide. He went into great detail however was able to keep the audience interested.
There is no way to get all of this info going it alone.

Tour was about and hour and a half. Tour was small groups of no more than 16. No queuing. Super organised. Tour guide was really knowledgable. We went on an 11am tour. Gets really busy so morning was great as we had the rest of the afternoon to explore.
Amazing. Tour guides very professional and informative definitely recommended. People are very friendly .
It’s definitely the best way to visit such a magnificent place. You get fast access to it, a great guide who will explain you everything in details. Perfect!

Scheduled this visit via my phone while in Atlanta (in transit) to Barcelona. I booked 3:00 pm tickets and received a confirmation e-mail with date, number of tickets, amount charged to my credit actors and reference number. At 9:15 am, the day of our scheduled tour, I re-opened my e-mail and proceeded to “get ticket” which showed our tour time at 9:00am .... 6 hours earlier than what I scheduled. The concierge at our hotel contacted the operator, Julia Travel, who indicated the earliest opportunity to reschedule was 4 days later at an additional cost of $22 per ticket. My itinerary did not allow for this and consequently, I paid $97 for something that I didn’t get.

Absolutely the most amazing structure that I have ever seen. The inside of this Gaudí masterpiece is a feast for the eyes. If you go to Barcelona...go here!

The tour operator was disorganised, lost customers pre entering the building, spent an hour counting people and taking tickets, left the group alone for 15 minutes standing in the sun, etc. Once we finally got inside the guide was informative but lacked passion- she deals with this chaos many times a day and it showed.

Suggest you book tickets on line (must) , hire electronic tour guide, and go yourself. It’s awesome.
No line....went right in. It was great! La Sagrada Familia is incredibly beautiful.....not to be missed!

We visited the Sagrada Familia. We bought advance tickets and went around 5 pm. The light hits the stained glass windows - stunning. We did the self guided tour with the listening devices. It took us over an hour which was just the right amount of time.

This was a good tour once we waited in line to get in for 30 plus minutes in the hot sun. There were multiple other tour groups there at the same time. The guide was informative. There was no special access to any part of the Cathedral other than everyone else. Didn’t see what the regular line looked like.

I would recommend this tour, the information it gives is excellent and the guide very well informed, I took my own head phones which made the tour more comfortable.
The jump the queue is a must and getting the 09.00 time slot meant less crowds, when we left it was very crowded.

The Sagrada Familia is just out of this world, both in size and detail on the outside and the vast colourful inside. It is hard to believe that one man was so inspired. Next visit 2030 when it is complete.
Very happy with the tour by Julia Travel. Very punctual, professional and helpful. Would definitely book through them again.

Beautiful architecture and a lot of history. If you love these two things, this is the spot for you. If you think that the Sagrada Familia looks amazing from the outside, wait to walk inside and find the real beauty. The tour will give you a more insight of what the sagrada familia is and means.
Fully recommend this tour. We had a great guide called Angela who was really informative and made the whole tour fascinating.

I was there on April 29, 2019 with my wife and two friends and took this tour. It was very interesting and I highly recommend it. One weird thing happened though. We were outside looking up at the spires when I felt a drop on my head. I wiped my forehead and it felt and looked like blood. My wife came over and cleaned me off with a tissue but I had no cuts or abrasions to cause this. It was very odd. Good tour though!

The tour was satisfactory for us, but we didn't anticipate the group size to be this large! There were at least 30 people in our group, and though we could hear our guide thanks to the audio guides, it was not possible to see for the whole group to see what he was pointing at. A smaller group size would be highly recommended for this tour.

Using Julia Travels was a great move on my part. Arrived on time and met Christine who led us all throughout La Família Sagrada Tour. There was a lot more information that I didn’t expect. Of course before traveling I read up some on La Família Sagrada and the tour was not only informative but very inspiring. You look at the architecture and how creative every part of the church is. Ever since I was a kid Spain has been the one of the main places I’ve ever wanted to visit. Seeing this as an adult was like well worth it. Seeing how each part of the church not only took time but it also too different architects and their interpretation of what they wanted to add to it. I suggest for anyone to use Julia Travels, and really take in everything they see and experience. I would definitely come back again to show my family this amazing piece of history.

The tour was hosted by a wonderful guide who was very knowledgeable and personable. She pointed out things hidden to the average person as well as described in detail the history and key points of construction along the way. I highly recommend this tour.
Priority acces and tour by an expert are a must. Otherwise, lots of time is wasted by finding your way around, then, making a long line, and then getting lost into such a majestic construction.

The tour of Sagrada Familia is a must for all visiting Barcelona. From the outside the Bascillica is beautiful but there is so much more. Learning about Gaudi's vision and meaning into all the details was amazing. Our guide was a little difficult to understand at times, however we were able to understand most of the tour.

This church might not appeal to everyone’s aesthetic however not even its biggest critic can deny that it is fascinating to look at. There is so much to see and learn from each wall and tower that spending the entire day is pretty easy.

There aren't enough words for the Sagrada Familia in Barcelona as it is so absolutely mind blowing. I would always go again and get the guided tour with the priority access as one has to queue otherwise for a rather long time.

Arriving at the desk of Julia Tours on December 30th, looking forward to a great experience, we found out we ordered the tour a day before, on December 29th. Indeed we made a mistake, but we booked this guided tour already months in advance to be 100% sure to have access to the Sagrada Familia, and that point we were sure to have ordered it for 30/12/18.
Of course the disappointment of my wife and myself was huge when the agent at the desk coldly stated we had made a mistake and that we couldn't get in the church anymore. The way the agent acted was appalling: a normal customer service agent would handle clients that ordered and paid for a visit 2 months in advance, feeling assured everything was OK, in a totally different way. We were feeling very bad. On top of that the travel agency "cashed" the money we paid, we only got bad feelings in return. We would have expected for a customer service agent to minimally try to find a way to get us in another guided group or compensate our bad experience in another way. I didn’t expect this kind of horrible customer service would still exist in the modern world.

If ever in Barcelona visit this place to see this amazing building.
One has to see it to understand fully, the amazing carvings etc.
Unfortunately was not able to see the inside of this magnificent church.
Even if you can see it from the outside its well worth a visit.
This place has Historical, Religious & Artistic value.

If you can make reservation in advance to get a tour guide, do so. Had a very good experience. We got a reservation for a tour guide. This means skip the several hours of waiting to get inside. Very nice place. Amazing does not describe it. Mind boggling is more like it. The natural lighting for the different season through the different stain glasses depending at what time of the year it is and the sun direction. Only through an experience guide, they can point out many details of this architecture that you would probably not notice. This is well worth the price and time to visit. Do not go to Barcelona if you are not planning to visit this magnificent church.
Absolutely beautiful to see - way too crowded even with the tickets for tour - would get there early and go yourself

Regretted booking this tour because:

1. The large size of the group, the tour guide's heavy Spanish accent and the lack of any audio devices made it virtually impossible to hear or understand the info. she was sharing during the tour of the exterior of the S.F.

2. The amt. of time spent touring/viewing the exterior was excessive, especially since the tour is marketed as a skip-the-line tour, the obvious implication being that the entire time of the tour will be spent in the interior of the S. F. since lines form for that, not to view the exterior.

3. Even with the audio devices provided by the S.F. for the part of the tour spent inside, it was still very difficult to understand the tour guide because of her accent.

The available self-guided audio tour of the interior of the S.F. would have been the better choice, even with having to stand in line to enter.

We took the 9a tour of Sagarda Familia with our guide Orio (Sorry of I spelled that wrong). He was informative and kept tour moving through the huge crowds. I would HIGHLY recommend going with a tour group to skip the lines and learn the most about the church and Gaudi. We did the tour and the spent another hour on our own looking around and going into the Passion Tower (not included in the ticket). The tour office is close to Sagrada Familia so it was very easy.

I purchased ticket skip the line for Sunday at 1pm. It was raining and I took taxi to reach the meeting point on time. Was very disappointed the guy told me the 1pm tour as canceled. He asked me to return tomorrow 12pm. Sagrada familia was good we went with the guide called Alberto. His knowledge is good. And he explains with joke.
We were in Barcelona for 2 1/2 days and took the hop on / off bus and arrived late afternoon to S.F.. At the stop there were no tickets available . This got us in.

Although The Church was quite impressive, we wish we had not paid the money for an English speaking guide, our guide’s English was comically mixed with wrong words so that we only sometimes had any idea what she was saying and she often positioned the group in the blazing sun, when shade was nearby... imagine lines like Disneyland with a guide you cannot understand... of course I’m sure it is luck of the draw. If we could do it over we may have just read the Wikipedia about it and admired it from the outside.

I'll be back in 2026 when this stunning architectural tribute is completed. It's visually stunning, almost impossible to comprehend. Wow. I fell in love with each visual experience of beauty. It's sad. It's happy. It's disrespectful. It's awesome. (Shout out to Dan Brown's Origins for peaking my interest.)
Julia Travel's guide was great, full of interesting facts and stories. The pace was good. Just the right amount of people. There was seating while we waited for the tour to begin. Do the tour early. The Sagrada Familia gets overwhelmingly crowded by 10 am...
Worth the trip. Book your tickets and go to the earlier tour. Gets too crowded later. Guide was knowledgeable and patiently answered all our questions. Definitely worth a visit.

My friend and I visited the cathedral on Sept 6 via the guided tour. The tour was excellent and Laura our guide was very knowledgeable. We definitely were able to skip the line which was incredibly long on a hot sunny day. We were provided with headphones for the tour so we could hear her and that was definitely a great idea. The church is the most amazing cathedral that we have ever seen.

We booked an English speaking tour but although our guide did speak English he was (obviously) Spanish and spoke far too quickly for us to understand what he said. He did acknowledge this and said he would try and speak more slowly but he didn’t. As the group was quite large it was difficult to get close to him to see what he was saying

The cathedral was absolutely amazing and we were so glad we visited but gained nothing from the guide and would have been better off using the self-guided tour. Disappointing 😞

You can only get tickets on line. We did not get to see inside, as it was book out for our last 2 days in Barcelona. Use the offical site to book your tickets. Next time for us maybe it will be finished by then

This is a must see attraction in Barcelona - the building is still a work in progress with several spires still to be completed. According to ou guide 2020 is the completion date (but I seriously doubt that this will be achieved!). Even with construction works going on the building is amazing & the interior (now completed) is jaw dropping. The way it has been designed means there are no pillars as you find in traditional old churches & cathedrals - it is very cleverly put together.

You simply must go with a guided tour - not only does it save you having to queue for tickets (in peak times these sell out well in advance, so you should book ahead online), your guide will provide you with background information on the history of the place, as well as where to get the best photos from, that you would otherwise not be made aware of.
Beautiful....everything inside and out. .the best Tour ever ...we are coming back d'Or sure......love it

The guide was ok but seemed quite new. She struggled to organise the group and was only holding a small bottle of water above her head, so hard to spot in a crowded place like this.
Her English was poor and she struggled to understand make herself understood initially.
Her knowledge of SF was good but there was a bit of repetition.
I'd look for a smaller group next time.
Breathtaking- will return in 2026 when it is completed- a huge ask though - Barcelona is a joy! The bus tours are a must and the Casa ballo deserves a visit

Our guide Isabel was incredibly knowledgeable about La Sagrada Familia and was able to answer every single question asked by our group (and there were some really unusual, difficult questions asked by people in our group). Her passion for the cathedral was obviously deep and she expressed that in every moment as she told us about the history of the building. We could not have been happier about our decision to book this tour in advance.

This is a truly amazing building, stretching the building techniques to the full. You can book online best the previous day if you want an early slot. The audio guide is good and allows you to skip parts that may not be of particular interest. You can go up the towers if you pay more, but you get the same view from El Corte Ingles Cafeteria on the ninth floor and in more comfort. Parking in the area is normal city prices.

I did use the priority access tour and while I enjoyed it very much, I was short on time and would have preferred a shorter tour. And I chose to go in the group tour which was a total of about 20 people. I rated it 5 stars b/c most people would like the length of the tour, just not me. The church is amazing so if you can only walk around the building, it is worth it for that alone. The stained glass inside is stunning. And the outside looks like it is "melting" but up close it is very detailed.

Great tour. Totally worth it. This area was one of the most densely packed in all of Barcelona and it helped to have a guide. There is just so much to learn about the Sagrada Familia. I feel that to visit this special place without a guided tour is to waste the occasion. Julia Travel's tour helped us make the most of a once-in-a-lifetime trip.
Worth a visit inside with a tour guide. The thought process behind this imaginative and we'll planned architecture makes for a completely different experience!

The Sagrada Familia priority access tour was fantastic. We had an English only guide, which meant all the information was exclusive to our ears only. Which also meant that we got alot of information, certainly alot more than if the tour was for dual languages. Our tour guide was very informative and we got so much out of the tour. We highly recommend that English speaking travelers take advantage of this option.

You have to watch the video to get a full appreciation of exactly what has happened but more importantly to see how it will progress in the future, at present still no end date can be even guessed but they have estimated another 5 - 10 years , however locals feel it will be more like 20 years. Having said that the progress in the last 12 months had out shone all forecasted predictions

The cathedral is the most amazing sight I have ever seen. The color and detail inside the church left us speechless. This is a sight that must not be missed. We purchased the skip the line pass and walked right in. Well worth the money.
The only negative was going to the old office and being hustled over to the new one. A map of the location of the agency with respect to the Basilica would have been nice for 1st timers in the area
I liked this tour. The place is fascinating. The guide speaks English and Spanish and that was annoying. Always ask for one language guide as when he has to speak in 2 languages, it becomes boring.

Visited this amazing building with my daughter (14) today. Unfortunately we couldn't enter the towers. Too much wind!? Anyway the building is impressive although a lot of construction is going on these days.

We got a free audio tour to replace the tower visit. Still a bit dissapointed, we were anxious to see the views and the rooftop etc.
Martha of Julia Travel gave a very good background and in depth history of the Sagrada Familia. She was very helpful entertaining questions and helping visitors understand Gaudi and his vision.

The Sagrada Familia is an amazing place and we were so glad to see the inside and to have a guide to point out things that we would have missed if we had done it all on our own. Ramon, our guide, was very informative and very enthusiastic. We learnt about the history of the building, what it was made from, Gaudi's influences and what he was trying to achieve. Fascinating. We were told that if we hadn't taken the tour the queue to get in was over 4 hours - so definitely worth the money just to skip the queue. On the day we took the tour, there was no availability to book on the day even in November so you need to book this in advance.
A impressive masterpiece! I is amazing how every detail was planned by Gaudi. He was an genius that as the time goes on is more and more appreciated.
The Temple is spectacular! Our guide, Berta was very knowledgeable and pleasant and thorough! It truly was an amazing experience!

If you visit Barcelona, this tour is a must. We enjoyed our tour of La Sagrada Familia. My only caution is that the directions to get to the meeting point were a bit challenging for us considering we just arrived in Barcelona and had a map and an address from our text messages from tripadvisor. We made it to the meeting point with time to spare, but was a bit confusing in the beginning.
It was smooth and informative. The office/ meet point was right across the street from the church which made it easy to find. The church is really cool.

Super east, quick, and walked right in with the 'skip the line' pass! Highly recommend! The church is a masterpiece - but you must go in! Don't just view the outside - the inside is absolutely a marvel of architecture!
One of the most interesting tours I have had, ever. Well worthwhile and the best way to learn about the Sagrada Familia.
